notes: Each *as far as* is taken whole for its own עַד, headed on the content word rather than a connective (rule 24).
*every man's* goes to אִישׁ, an English possessive taking the determiner of the possessor (rules 15, 29).
The directive he takes the *toward* written for it as its own unit (rule 32); the marginal Hebrew gloss decides nothing (rule 38).
